quote: we evaluate synthetic generations based on several metrics. Self-BLEU measures lexical diversity of a corpus of texts based on ngram overlap between pairs of examples. Entity entropy measures the diversity of entities in the generated texts using the distribution of each of 16 entity-types (inferred from a pre-trained named entity recognition model). MAUVE measures closeness to human-written text using representations from a pre-trained GPT2-XL model. We also measure the student accuracy when trained on the synthetic data.
